name: Plate VII: The Eye of Ra
description: The burning Eye of Ra: the sun-disc winged by Horus of Behdet and girded by twin uraei, its rays falling as hands that offer life, above a wall of the sacred writing. Struck in Solar Lapis: lapis and beaten gold, the colours of the sun-god's temple. One of the Seven Hierophants: a single plate, composed by hand, of which there is no other.
